records.name: 도현
records.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: individual fictional web-drama casting candidate photograph for '삭제된 11초'. Make ONE full-length vertical studio photograph of one original adult Korean character, not a collage. Head, body, hands and both feet fully visible with clear margin, centered upright relaxed stance facing camera, neutral camera at mid-torso, natural approximately seven-heads-tall adult proportions with balanced torso and legs. Plain pale warm-gray seamless background, soft neutral studio daylight, realistic skin and fabric detail, accurate hands, subtle professional casting-portrait polish. Attractive screen-actor presence. No text, labels, watermarks or extra people. Each candidate is a different fictional person whose facial proportions distinguish them; referenced actors are aesthetic inspiration, not an assertion about those actors or a scene depicting the real actors.
Character and fixed design: Kim Do-hyeon, 35-year-old Korean man. User wants the sophisticated handsome leading-man atmosphere of Korean actor Lee Jong-won (이종원): lean refined face, striking long eyes, sculpted straight nose, quietly seductive and stylish presence, clean-shaven, dark hair with a natural gently parted fringe. He is a FICTIONAL husband role in a suspense drama, photographed as a neutral casting portrait, not the real actor in an allegation or real event. Slightly restrained friendly expression, no villain smirk. Slate-blue button-down shirt, dark navy trousers, simple black wristwatch on left wrist, dark plain flat shoes. Balanced lean physique, no exaggerated muscles, scars or gloves.
Specific distinct candidate: A: long lean oval face, horizontally long single-lid eyes, tall straight nose, medium natural lips, clean subtle sensual charisma.
records.review: 전신, 푸른 셔츠·남색 바지·검은 구두·시계, 세련된 남성 인상 확인. 손은 주머니에 들어가 있으며 얼굴 후보는 미선택.
